title: Function coverage for Write Single Register
purpose: Cover the addressed single-register write path with a valid 0x06 request using a concrete register address and 16-bit value to expand parser entry-point diversity beyond control functions.
expected_behavior: The endpoint should parse function 0x06, interpret address 0x002a and value 0x1234 as a single holding-register write, and either echo the request fields on success or return a standard exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP Length is 0006, matching unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU.
Function 0x06 is used as documented for Write Single Register.
The request preserves the 2-byte register address followed by the 2-byte register value layout.
Chosen address and value are benign coverage values, not copied from any historical issue payload.
issue_safety_notes: This is a baseline valid write seed with no malformed counts, no truncation, and no issue-trigger replication.
